title: PageKit / Class Player / whiteboard R07 recovery

Current/Catalog/Lineage authority remains external to this recovery workstream.
pagekit-v26 is the stable-class-player rollback donor / positive rollback fossil in Lineage.
pagekit-v37 is a capability candidate whose laser transform tracking is best-known, while its whole UX is not Human Accepted.
The Psicoanálisis PageKit surface is a distinct consumer/integration artifact and must not be silently treated as the owner of the Class Player lineage.
Do not infer Human Accepted, Current or Served state from version number, catalog liveness or a recovered file.
Agent Network owns coordination/network/**. R07 does not claim that subtree or DELTA_FEED as material scope; its one worker-status object is only the runtime-mandated independent status write.
ref_convention: Reads explicitly name main, gh-pages runtime, or the recovery branch. Source pages and authority graphs are read-only unless their existing owner later authorizes a change.
